finalText: Fixed. `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:41` was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount — contradicting its own doc comment ("tax is charged on the amount the customer pays"). One-line fix: compute tax on `discounted` instead of `cents`. Suite now runs 625/625 passing, and `verify.js` confirms it's the real fix (not a spec/runner tamper).
